title: Computer Use
description: After you authorize the current conversation, AI can observe and operate the full Windows desktop, including opening apps that are not running yet.
unsupported: Computer Use currently supports Windows x64 only. Other features are unaffected.
ownershipMismatch: Another conversation still controls the desktop. Stop that operation before authorizing this conversation.
noSession: Create or open a conversation in the sidebar, then return here to authorize it.
chat: Return to chat to give instructions
noHidden: No legacy hidden windows need restoring.
shortcutHelp: When the main window is hidden, use the system tray or configured shortcut to recall it or stop computer use.
shortcutsUnavailable: The system tray and recall shortcuts are unavailable.

phases.idle: Enabled. Authorize the current conversation to begin.
phases.ready: Authorized. AI can operate the full desktop.
phases.running: AI is observing or operating the desktop. You can pause or stop at any time.
phases.error: Control cannot continue. See the message below.

errors.generic: Computer Use is temporarily unavailable. Retry the status or stop computer use.
errors.backend_not_bundled: The computer use backend is missing. In development, prepare bundled resources; for installed builds, reinstall the complete Windows version.
errors.backend_integrity_failed: Backend integrity verification failed. Nothing was started. Reinstall the complete version.
errors.stale_reference: The desktop changed. Ask AI to observe again before acting.
errors.stop_failed: The backend has not confirmed that it stopped or released input. Stop computer use again.
errors.restore_failed: Some legacy hidden windows could not be restored. Recovery records were preserved; try again.
errors.recovery_failed: Legacy window recovery records could not be read. Repair the records and restart the app.
errors.invalid_session: This conversation is no longer running. Open it before granting access.
errors.desktop_owned: Another conversation still controls the desktop. Stop it before switching conversations.
errors.recall_unavailable: Neither the tray nor recall shortcut is available. The main window will remain visible so computer use can be stopped.
errors.capture_unavailable: The current desktop could not be captured.
